metadata.description: Get the Canada Post rate for a letter in a standard envelope weighing 80 g, sent from postal code M5S 2H7 to postal code V6B 1A1 in Canada

common_info.email_credentials: credentials to use the assigned disposable email account
common_info.user_info: alex_green_personal_info.json; the dummy user's personal information
common_info.user_resume: PDF resume with disposable email account injected

instruction: Open https://www.canadapost-postescanada.ca/cpc/en/tools/find-a-rate.page. Get the Canada Post rate for a letter in a standard envelope weighing 80 g, sent from postal code M5S 2H7 to postal code V6B 1A1 in Canada. Choose the letter or document option, not a package. The outcome is the request for the letter rate; buying stamps is not required.
